title: health check endpoint returns service status
description: Verify that the /health GET endpoint returns a 200 status code with a JSON object containing the service status as a string, indicating the service is healthy.

title: essay judge endpoint validates essay quality
description: Test the /essay/judge POST endpoint by submitting essays with varying lengths, information density, and logical validity. Verify that the response correctly indicates pass or fail for each criterion with detailed rationale, and includes the essay_id and idempotency_key.
